push.title: Notifications on this device
push.privacy: Notifications go through your browser vendor's push service, which sees that a message was sent to you, and when. Content is encrypted.
push.failed: Could not enable notifications; they may be blocked for this site.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
updates.title: Updates
updates.privacy: Checks GitHub for new releases at most every 12 hours, sending nothing about this server.
export.accountIntro: Download your account data as a JSON file: profile, preferences, memberships, your completed chores, channel names (never their addresses), devices and sign-in history.
transfer.title: Export and import
transfer.intro: Back up or move this household as a JSON file: chores, areas, settings and history, but no notification addresses, calendar links or tokens.
transfer.fileHint: A Gunkly household export (.json), up to 5 MB.
transfer.modeNew: A new household (you become its owner)
transfer.modeMergeHint: Same-named areas are combined and chores are added as new. Non-member assignees become “anyone”.
transfer.tooLarge: That file is larger than 5 MB.
transfer.sumUnassigned: Chores set to “anyone” (assignees not members here): {count}
import.err.not_json: That file can't be read. Choose a Gunkly export (.json).
import.err.format: That isn't a Gunkly household export file.
import.err.version: That file is from a different version of Gunkly and can't be imported.
import.err.limit_chores: The file has more chores than this household may have.
import.err.limit_areas: The file has more areas than this household may have.
import.err.limit_reminders: A chore in the file has more reminders than allowed.
import.err.limit_completions: A chore in the file has more history than allowed.
